recipes.title: Design page layouts and scalable artwork
recipes.description: Match the tool to page layout, vector illustration, everyday documents or programmable typesetting.

picks.label: Print layout
picks.reason: Page layout, color management and PDF output suit brochures and multi-page publications.
picks.tradeoff: Check imported assets and press requirements; proprietary layout-document interchange is limited.

picks.label: Vector artwork
picks.reason: SVG-native editing suits icons, logos and illustrations that must remain scalable.
picks.tradeoff: It is primarily a drawing workflow; complex multi-page publishing needs a layout application.

picks.label: Office documents
picks.reason: Writer, Calc and Impress cover ordinary documents without a separate publishing stack.
picks.tradeoff: Complex imported Office files and macros need compatibility checks.

picks.label: Programmable documents
picks.reason: The open-source compiler and templates support repeatable technical reports.
picks.tradeoff: The markup workflow and hosted-editor plans differ from traditional desktop word processing.

recipes.title: Inspect and process image files
recipes.description: Choose for RAW development, minimal viewing, broad browsing or repeatable image processing.

picks.label: RAW photography
picks.reason: Non-destructive processing and image-library tools fit photographic development.
picks.tradeoff: Learn the processing pipeline and verify camera support.

picks.label: Minimal viewing
picks.reason: A sparse viewer interface keeps attention on the image.
picks.tradeoff: It omits full cataloging and photo-editing features.

picks.label: Browse and batch
picks.reason: Viewing, metadata and batch conversion are available in one application.
picks.tradeoff: Company use needs an appropriate paid license.

picks.label: Scripted processing
picks.reason: Command-line transforms support repeatable conversion and image-composition pipelines.
picks.tradeoff: Build options, delegates and security policy affect supported formats.

recipes.title: Trim, convert and inspect media
recipes.description: Use the operation you need to choose between trimming, transcoding, container changes and technical inspection.

picks.label: Trim without full re-encoding
picks.reason: Stream-preserving cuts suit long recordings with unwanted sections.
picks.tradeoff: Keyframes constrain some cuts; store builds and direct-download pricing differ.

picks.label: Graphical conversion
picks.reason: An FFmpeg-based desktop interface exposes production-oriented conversion and rewrapping.
picks.tradeoff: Quality and delivery compatibility depend on the selected settings.

picks.label: Matroska tracks
picks.reason: Dedicated muxing and metadata tools manage tracks and chapters in MKV files.
picks.tradeoff: This does not replace a video-effects or general transcoding workflow.

picks.label: Diagnose a file
picks.reason: Reports codecs, tracks and technical properties before import or delivery.
picks.tradeoff: Inspection does not repair the file.

recipes.title: Create and time subtitles
recipes.description: Compare a broad subtitle-editing workflow with detailed styled subtitle typesetting.

picks.label: General subtitle work
picks.reason: Timing, conversion and video-assisted editing cover common subtitle preparation tasks.
picks.tradeoff: Runtime and media dependencies differ by platform.

picks.label: Styled typesetting
picks.reason: Audio timing, ASS styling and video preview support detailed subtitle placement.
picks.tradeoff: Player support for complex ASS styling varies.

recipes.title: Write music notation and guitar tabs
recipes.description: Choose among visual score entry, reproducible engraving and instrument-specific notation.

picks.label: Visual score editing
picks.reason: An open-source desktop score editor combines notation, playback and part extraction.
picks.tradeoff: The desktop app is distinct from paid score-sharing and optional sound services.

picks.label: Text-based engraving
picks.reason: Notation source can be versioned and compiled into printable scores.
picks.tradeoff: Learning the notation language is required.

picks.label: LilyPond editor
picks.reason: Editing aids and preview provide a focused environment for LilyPond projects.
picks.tradeoff: LilyPond remains a separate required engraving engine.

picks.label: Guitar tablature
picks.reason: Tablature and playback fit guitar-oriented composing and practice.
picks.tradeoff: Check import fidelity and the newer file format before sharing with older versions.

recipes.title: Build a software synthesis workspace
recipes.description: Compare modular patching, a broad hybrid synth and a focused FM instrument.

picks.label: Modular composition
picks.reason: Visual patching combines synthesis, sequencing and processing modules.
picks.tradeoff: Its workflow differs from a conventional linear DAW.

picks.label: Virtual modular rack
picks.reason: A module ecosystem and cable-based patching fit modular-synthesis study and sound design.
picks.tradeoff: Rack Free, Rack Pro and third-party modules have separate feature and licensing choices.

picks.label: Free hybrid instrument
picks.reason: Multiple synthesis methods and modulation options provide a broad sound-design palette.
picks.tradeoff: Plugin compatibility and complex-patch CPU demands need checking.

picks.label: FM specialist
picks.reason: DX7-inspired FM synthesis and patch workflows suit a specific sound-design approach.
picks.tradeoff: It is intentionally narrower than a general-purpose synthesizer.

recipes.title: Choose a personal knowledge base
recipes.description: Decide whether notebooks, local Markdown, hierarchical rich notes or plain-text sync integration best match your work.

picks.label: Open-source notebooks
picks.reason: Markdown notes, notebooks and several synchronization options suit a conventional research notebook.
picks.tradeoff: Hosted Joplin Cloud is optional and paid; test sync and restore behavior.

picks.label: Local linked files
picks.reason: Markdown vaults and links support a flexible, local-file knowledge graph.
picks.tradeoff: The app is proprietary; optional Sync and Publish services are paid.

picks.label: Rich hierarchy
picks.reason: Nested notes and multiple note types suit a structured personal knowledge base.
picks.tradeoff: Scripting and self-hosted options add administration responsibilities.

picks.label: Plain-text workflow
picks.reason: Markdown files and optional Nextcloud/ownCloud integration suit file-centered note management.
picks.tradeoff: The synchronization service is a separate component to configure.

recipes.title: Scan, search and organize paperwork
recipes.description: Choose a scanning interface, an automated OCR pipeline, or a focused page organizer.

picks.label: Scan to searchable PDF
picks.reason: Scanner acquisition, page handling and OCR are available in a desktop interface.
picks.tradeoff: Driver support and scan quality affect the result.

picks.label: Automated PDF OCR
picks.reason: A command-line workflow adds searchable text layers to existing scanned PDFs.
picks.tradeoff: Language packs, dependencies and OCR review are required.

picks.label: Organize pages
picks.reason: Merge, split, crop and reorder PDF pages interactively.
picks.tradeoff: It does not replace text editing or a redaction tool.

picks.label: Read and annotate
picks.reason: Document viewing and PDF annotation support reviewing the result.
picks.tradeoff: Annotation interoperability and platform packaging should be tested.

recipes.title: Analyze scientific images and simulation output
recipes.description: Match microscopy images, Python-based image stacks or simulation meshes to the appropriate analysis environment.

picks.label: Microscopy toolbox
picks.reason: The ImageJ distribution bundles many scientific imaging tools and plugins.
picks.tradeoff: Validate the chosen analysis and plugin versions before drawing conclusions.

picks.label: Python image stacks
picks.reason: Multidimensional viewing and Python integration fit custom scientific imaging workflows.
picks.tradeoff: Manage the Python environment, plugin versions and memory needs.

picks.label: Simulation visualization
picks.reason: Data readers and a visualization pipeline fit numerical and mesh-based simulation outputs.
picks.tradeoff: Large datasets and specialized formats require resource planning.

recipes.title: Map and process geospatial data
recipes.description: Choose a desktop map-making environment, analysis engine, terrain specialist or point-cloud pipeline.

picks.label: Desktop GIS
picks.reason: Map composition and spatial editing support a broad geographic-information workflow.
picks.tradeoff: Coordinate systems, data quality and plugins need review.

picks.label: Repeatable geospatial analysis
picks.reason: Dedicated raster/vector modules and scripting suit analytical processing.
picks.tradeoff: Region and projection concepts have a learning curve.

picks.label: Terrain specialist
picks.reason: Terrain, raster and geoscience modules support elevation-derived analysis.
picks.tradeoff: Check module behavior and version-specific file support.

picks.label: Point-cloud automation
picks.reason: Pipeline-based filtering and conversion suit batch LiDAR processing.
picks.tradeoff: A separate viewer helps inspect the results.

recipes.title: Design and simulate electronics
recipes.description: Compare complete PCB design, a structured component workflow, accessible prototype documentation and circuit simulation.

picks.label: PCB design suite
picks.reason: Schematic capture, board layout and 3D viewing cover a complete board-design workflow.
picks.tradeoff: Footprints and manufacturing outputs need checking against actual components and fabrication rules.

picks.label: Integrated component libraries
picks.reason: A consistent schematic/board/library model suits repeatable component-driven designs.
picks.tradeoff: Confirm library coverage and advanced board requirements.

picks.label: Prototype documentation
picks.reason: Breadboard, schematic and board views suit visually documenting accessible electronics projects.
picks.tradeoff: Official binaries are paid; component accuracy still needs review.

picks.label: Circuit simulation
picks.reason: A graphical front end connects schematics with several SPICE-compatible simulators.
picks.tradeoff: Models and simulator selection determine the validity of results.

recipes.title: Analyze tabular scientific data
recipes.description: Compare conventional statistics, Bayesian workflows, visual data mining and matrix-based numerical programming.

picks.label: Spreadsheet-style statistics
picks.reason: A graphical data editor and R-based analyses suit teaching and common statistical tasks.
picks.tradeoff: Choose the model and assumptions deliberately; extra modules may be required.

picks.label: Frequentist and Bayesian analysis
picks.reason: Graphical analysis and reporting cover both statistical approaches.
picks.tradeoff: Interpretation and study design remain the responsibility of the analyst.

picks.label: Visual analysis workflows
picks.reason: Connected widgets make exploratory analysis and machine-learning steps visible.
picks.tradeoff: Validate data splits and defaults to avoid misleading results.

picks.label: Numerical programming
picks.reason: Matrix-oriented syntax supports custom numerical experiments and plotting.
picks.tradeoff: Compatibility with MATLAB toolboxes and specialized integrations is incomplete.
